title: perilla urticifolia
intro: Perilla urticifolia, commonly known as beefsteak plant or Perilla, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is native to East Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, alleviating allergy symptoms, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Perilla urticifolia include anti-allergic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-asthmatic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as perillaldehyde and limonene. These constituents have been shown to have a positive effect on cardiovascular health and may also have antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
